CustomField.inlineHelpText: The printable heading for this table, snapshotted from the table definition at generation time. This - not Name - is what a document prints. Name carries the quote number so the record is findable in a list view, which would put Q-00063 in the middle of the customer's document. There is no fallback to Table_Name__c: an active definition with no Display Title fails config load, because a silent fallback is how half the tables end up printing an admin-facing name nobody reviewed.
CustomField.label: Display Title
